name: officeimo-document-tools
description: Compact local OfficeIMO document and mailbox MCP tools plus contributor workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect local documents and mailboxes with bounded OfficeIMO tools.
interface.longDescription: OfficeIMO Document Tools lets Codex inspect, search, selectively fetch, and convert documents and mail stores through a compact workspace-scoped STDIO MCP server. It also includes contributor workflows for conversion, PDF, website, build, and release work.
defaultPrompt: Inspect and summarize this local document with OfficeIMO.
Search this PST or OST and fetch only the relevant messages.
Convert this local document to Markdown with OfficeIMO.
